psychological_meaning: Brown Tumbleweed evokes feelings of stability, resilience, and connection to nature. It suggests a sense of grounding, reliability, and quiet strength, often associated with rustic landscapes and natural materials. It can represent endurance and steadfastness in the face of challenges.
